definitions.gloss: hot pot dish; one-pot meal; nabe cuisine
definitions.explanation: A category of Japanese dishes cooked and served in a communal pot at the table. Ingredients typically include vegetables, tofu, meat or seafood, and broth. A quintessential winter food in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{鍋物|なべもの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{食|た}べたく→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: On cold days, I crave hot pot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今夜|こんや}→今夜：01411_konya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{鍋物|なべもの}にしない?

{鍋物|なべもの}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{囲|かこ}んで→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{集|あつ}まり→集まり：01689_atsumari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ぴったり→ぴったり：02362_pittari⟧だ。
examples.english: Hot pot is perfect for winter gatherings because everyone eats together around the pot.

notes:
An umbrella term for various hot pot dishes. Often shortened to ⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧ in casual speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鍋物|なべもの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{囲|かこ}む→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧ (to gather around a hot pot)
- {鍋物|なべもの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧ (hot pot season)
- {鍋物|なべもの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{具|ぐ}→具：07857_gu⟧ (hot pot ingredients)

TYPES:
Common types include ⟦すき{焼|や}き→すき焼き：10368_sukiyaki⟧ (sukiyaki), ⟦しゃぶしゃぶ→しゃぶしゃぶ：10479_shabushabu⟧ (shabu-shabu), ⟦{寄|よ}せ{鍋|なべ}→寄せ鍋：22816_yosenabe⟧ (assorted hot pot), ⟦{水炊|みずた}き→水炊き：28920_mizutaki⟧ (chicken hot pot), and ⟦キムチ{鍋|なべ}→キムチ鍋：28937_kimuchinabe⟧ (kimchi hot pot).

CULTURAL NOTE:
{鍋物|なべもの} is strongly associated with winter and communal eating. Sharing a pot symbolizes warmth and togetherness. After the main ingredients are eaten, rice or noodles are often added to the remaining broth as a ⟦{締|し}め→締め：16134_shime⟧ (finishing course).
